name: Taylor

nadir.desc: The property consists of a long rectangular structure with a bright green metal roof|A dirt and gravel driveway runs along one side of the building|Open grassy lawn surrounds the structure|Mature evergreen trees are present near the building and across the lot|Additional structures and open ground are visible nearby.

alpha.desc: The front of the property shows a long structure with a green metal roof set in open grass|A large evergreen tree stands near the building|Dirt and gravel surfaces provide vehicle access along one side|Open lawn and additional trees extend across the lot.

bravo.desc: The left side of the structure shows the green metal roof and dark exterior walls|Vehicles are parked on the dirt surface near the building|Mature trees and vegetation frame this side|Open grassy areas continue around the property.

charlie.desc: The rear of the structure shows the back elevation with the green metal roof|Open grassy lawn extends behind the building|A dirt driveway continues past the structure|Mature trees and fencing are present along portions of the lot|Additional buildings are visible nearby.

delta.desc: The right side of the structure shows the green metal roof and open grassy areas|Mature trees border this side of the property|Dirt and gravel surfaces provide access near the building|Open space surrounds the structure.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a dirt and gravel driveway that leads from the road to the structure and surrounding open areas. The lot has extensive open grassy space suitable for emergency vehicle staging. Mature evergreen trees are present but do not fully enclose the building. Additional structures are located nearby on the property. Overall access and visibility are good due to the open rural layout.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle access available around all sides of the main structure?
